title: Cancellation of local finite type for algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $X,Y,Z$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. For a morphism of algebraic spaces, locally of finite type means locally of finite type on compatible etale scheme charts, using [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $a:X\to Y$ and $b:Y\to Z$ be morphisms. If $b\circ a:X\to Z$ is locally of finite type, then $a:X\to Y$ is locally of finite type. No finite-type, separatedness, or representability-by-schemes assumption on $b$ is imposed.

proof.text: Choose a surjective etale scheme atlas $W\to Z$ using [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Form $Y_W=Y\times_ZW$, choose a surjective etale scheme atlas $V\to Y_W$, and form $X_V=X\times_YV$ and a surjective etale scheme atlas $U\to X_V$. These fibre products are algebraic spaces by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers], so each atlas exists. The projections give scheme morphisms $\alpha:U\to V$ and $\beta:V\to W$ and a commutative diagram over $X\xrightarrow{a}Y\xrightarrow{b}Z$.

source.place: Tag 02X1 (lemma-lift-morphism-presentations), construction of compatible atlases; Tag 02X2 (lemma-fibre-product-spaces); Tag 025Y (definition-algebraic-space).

proof.text: Write $X_W=X\times_ZW$. The projection $Y_W\to Y$ is the pullback of $W\to Z$, hence is surjective etale. Thus $V\to Y$ is surjective etale by [lem-trf-space-chartwise-etale-permanence]. Also $X_V\cong X_W\times_{Y_W}V$: on every test scheme both sides consist of triples $(x,v,w)$ with $a(x)$ equal to the image of $v$ in $Y$ and $w$ equal to the image of $v$ in $W$; forgetting and restoring $w$ give inverse maps. Consequently $X_V\to X_W$ is the pullback of $V\to Y_W$ and is surjective etale by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Its composite $U\to X_W$ is surjective etale by [lem-trf-space-chartwise-etale-permanence].

source.place: Tag 041F (lemma-etale), clauses (2) and (3); spaces.tex Tag 02X1 (lemma-lift-morphism-presentations), pullback construction.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-local-properties-chart-test] with $P=$ locally of finite type to $b\circ a$, using the atlas $W\to Z$ and the surjective etale scheme map $U\to X_W$ verified in step 2. The hypothesis on $b\circ a$ gives that $\beta\circ\alpha:U\to W$ is locally of finite type. Clause (a) of [lemma-nagata-finite-type-to-separated-target], applied to the scheme triangle $U\xrightarrow{\alpha}V\xrightarrow{\beta}W$, now gives that $\alpha$ is locally of finite type. This clause requires no hypothesis on $\beta$.

source.place: Tag 0462 (lemma-permanence-finite-type), final sentence: Tag 040Y (lemma-finite-type-local) and morphisms.tex Tag 01T8 (lemma-permanence-finite-type).

proof.text: Finally apply [lem-sfb-space-local-properties-chart-test] to $a:X\to Y$. Its target chart is the surjective etale scheme map $V\to Y$ from step 2, and its source chart is exactly the chosen surjective etale map $U\to X\times_YV$. Since their scheme map $\alpha:U\to V$ is locally of finite type by step 3, the criterion gives that $a$ is locally of finite type.

source.place: Tag 0462 (lemma-permanence-finite-type), conclusion using Tag 040Y (lemma-finite-type-local), conditions (7) and (8).
